notes: The portable C++ TCK pair first checks p. 220 l. 5-13 by rejecting a committed source region containing TckUnrelatedDimension with InvalidRegionContext, after confirming that dimension is unavailable to the object class; the existing valid X/Y registration/update is the positive control. It then exercises Divestiture If Wanted after the original owner used a non-default update region, transfers ownership, and moves receiver subscriptions away from the old source region. Reacquisition does not restore the lost association until explicit reassociation restores the source-region callback. This is bounded evidence for the dimension-subset and selected ownership-loss rules only; other transfer paths and conformance remain separate.

requirements.statement: Region realizations generated for update of an instance attribute shall contain only dimensions available to that instance attribute. The TCK creates and commits a region for a valid federation dimension unavailable to TckObject, requires InvalidRegionContext from Register Object Instance With Regions, and then confirms the valid X/Y region registration and update remain accepted.

If a region other than the default region is used for update of a particular instance attribute by a joined federate and the joined federate loses ownership of that instance attribute, that region shall no longer be used for update of that instance attribute.

In all cases, if a joined federate divests ownership of an instance attribute with which an update region is associated, that association shall be lost, as if the Unassociate Regions For Updates service had been invoked for that (object instance, region, attribute) triple.

Update region associations that are lost shall not come into effect if the joined federate subsequently acquires ownership of the instance attribute unless the joined federate explicitly recreates the association.
